civilization.title: Civilization
civilization.subtitle: The Compass — A framework for evaluating the direction of intelligent civilizations.
civilization.author: Vinay Pasricha
civilization.thesis: Intelligence evolves along eight identifiable directions — four Foundations (Continuity, Truth, Capability, Cooperation) and four Frontiers (Expansion, Creation, Recursion, Purpose). A civilizational compass, not a map.

structure.part_one: The Compass — the case for direction, the four tests, the reduction, falsification
structure.part_two: The Eight Directions — one chapter per direction, plus interlude and closing
structure.part_three: Reading a Civilization — method applied to Rome, China, Modernity, and AI
structure.epilogue: Standing at the Edge of the Map

civilization.note: Full text extracted from the 19-file print HTML manuscript. Source HTML (with illustrations and typeset structure) preserved under library/civilization/source/. Ready for a runtime to be built on top.
